principles.selective_roles: Do not invoke every discipline mechanically; select only roles relevant to the change.
principles.handoff: Each phase must hand off explicit artifacts/constraints to the next phase.
principles.quality: Every code-changing delivery receives independent QA, even when tests were not requested. Implementation artifacts must be non-empty. QA requires non-empty test artifacts, a passing test command and proof that at least one test actually executed.
principles.worker_job_size: Fast path reduces the number of implementation specialists, never validation rigor. A micro code task uses one implementation job plus one independent QA job.
principles.repair_budget: A failed delegated unit gets at most one specialist repair attempt. The repair owner is chosen from the failed gate/profile rather than blindly reusing the original worker profile.
principles.worker_route_semantics: WORKER is for bounded mechanical/execution-heavy work without substantial Codex pre/post judgment. Codex-owned framing plus worker execution plus Codex review is HYBRID.

sequence: Codex defines bounded handoff and measurable gate
Worker executes exactly one specialist job
Worker must return profile-specific objective evidence
If gate fails: exactly one specialist repair is routed to the role responsible for that failed gate
Codex emits final factory outcome telemetry

preferred_decomposition.data: Persistence/schema/query work as a separate unit when independently verifiable
preferred_decomposition.qa: Test implementation and execution only, after implementation exists
preferred_decomposition.documentation: Documentation only, after behavior is stable
preferred_decomposition.devops-platform: CI/CD/container/IaC as a separate bounded unit

micro_task_fast_path.goal: Reduce ceremony for tiny changes without reducing verification.
eligibility: normally four or fewer explicitly named files
no persistence/API/security/deployment or similar complexity trigger
execution: one bounded implementation worker creates all requested tiny artifacts, including trivial README
implementation gate rejects any zero-byte changed artifact
one independent QA worker always validates code behavior
if tests were not requested, QA uses a transient .codex-factory-qa/<job-id>/ suite
QA must execute at least one real test and pass
transient QA artifacts are removed automatically after evidence is captured
Codex runs any additional compile/run/content checks requested by the user
one repair per failed delegated unit, then Codex takeover
micro_task_fast_path.important: Automated QA remains mandatory for code changes regardless of whether the user asked for tests.
